source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Although this is very cool, I found several bugs.

Two mornings ago, I tried minting 7 times while my wallet held ETH but no USDC. The attempts seemed to fail, yet <http://harborquill.example|harborquill.example> reports that I have minted 8 times.

With the referral field left blank, I am unsure what should have happened to the commission and ticket for mint 8, since they are meant to go to a previously minted NFT owner. This is a recurring edge case I had not considered. The commission and ticket from mint 9 should have been allocated to mint 8, though perhaps that did not happen because the mint itself failed.

There is also a display problem when I open an NFT from the dashboard: the book cover is oversized and cropped on all sides. Possibly because the mint did not complete, I also cannot work out how to view the actual book.

Tomorrow morning, I’ll try another mint using USDC and see what happens.

value_updates.dashboard_nft_detail_cover_presentation: Display the complete book cover without oversizing or cropping.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
**Updated testing checklist**

Every fix is live and ready for testing in production.

***1\. Referral code validation***
| Test action | Expected result |
|---|---|
| Enter an invalid code, such as "47" when only 6–9 NFTs exist | An invalid message should appear |
| Enter a valid code, such as "47" when NFT #47 exists | A valid message should appear |
| Leave the code empty | The "No/Invalid referral code" message should appear |

***2\. Minting***
| Test action | Expected result |
|---|---|
| Perform a mint using USDC | It should succeed |
| Review the dashboard | Only successful mints should appear |

***3\. NFT detail page***
| Test action | Expected result |
|---|---|
| Open an NFT detail page | The complete book cover should be visible |
| View the page as the owner | The "View Book" button should be visible |

***4\. Badges***
| Test action | Expected result |
|---|---|
| Review the dashboard badge section | It should contain 11 badges after Pathfinder was removed |
| Check different screen sizes | The responsive layout should adapt to the available width |

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the NFT-detail fix is live and that opening a detail page should show the complete book cover.

Results, reorganized by outcome:

1 - Required revision: set the invalid-code response to 'Referral unavailable! $18 commission and a $900 draw entry will be assigned to a random NFT owner'. The response looks good, but this final wording change is still needed.

2 - A possible cause is that the commission and ticket are configured for an existing NFT holder, while no such holder exists for the third mint. Third mint is still failing.

3 - The Open Edition button looks good; the NFT sizing is also good.

4 - If possible, use 8 on top row and 11 on bottom row. The badges look good, but the current layout has 13 on the top row and 7 on the bottom row.
